text: CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION slice 1 at exact SHA 012a24a11d0d95995851a0cb077a4dc881a23f6a on fable/catalog-action-unification-20260820 (pushed, based cf649c1). WHAT: the provider-pathway rule is now ONE predicate in shared/research/master-offerings/pathway-authority.ts, consulted by server/research/master-offerings/action.ts. It refuses on FAMILY as well as display state. MEASURED: on the shipped 420-row dataset the widened rule refuses exactly the rows the old rule refused (test asserts zero moved), so nothing rendered changes today. WHY IT MATTERS: 0aba726 fixed the care_pathway display-state hole; the assisted-order lane ALSO refuses the whole clinical_formulations_503a family, master-offerings did not. All 242 503A rows carry care_pathway today so the lanes agree by data, not by code - one workbook cell edit publishing a 503A row as available_now would have offered Add to Cart on a compounded clinical formulation the moment RESEARCH_MASTER_OFFERINGS_DIRECT_COMMERCE is turned on. 58% of the catalog is that family. FOR THE ASSISTED-ORDER LANE OWNER (I did not edit their file): production-catalog.ts authorityFor names only clinical_formulations_503a, so it would call a priced+bound row in clinician_guided_care or provider_network direct-eligible. Both families have zero published variants so it is inert; my test fails the moment either gets one. Suggested one-line change for that lane: derive providerWorkflowRequired from requiresProviderPathway({family, displayState, variantDisplayState}) instead of the inline expression at production-catalog.ts:109-111.
